task.ques: Identify the latest top-trending open-source project in the topic of 'Machine Learning' on GitHub, and check the number of stars it has received.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: TensorFlow (tensorflow/tensorflow) leads GitHub's Machine learning topic under “Most stars,” with 201,272 stars (displayed as 201k), checked October 28, 2026.
Evidence: https://github.com/topics/machine-learning — TensorFlow is the first result with Language: All and Sort: Most stars; its star-count element states “201272 users starred this repository.” GitHub describes it as “An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone.” Repository: https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow (Apache-2.0 license).
This is the topic's total-star ranking. GitHub's Trending page has no topic filter, and its Today, This week, and This month lists contained no repository tagged machine-learning when checked.
Screenshot: final.png.
